visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-angle drone shot of a tiered waterfall cascading over large, flat rocks into a turquoise pool, with a suspension bridge visible in the foreground. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a vibrant yellow long-sleeve top and light-blue denim shorts, walks along a stone path beside a pond with lily pads. (2) The scene transitions to a mountain road with double yellow lines, then to the woman and a man in a red polo shirt walking across a bright red wooden bridge in a forest. The woman is later seen walking across a long, metal-mesh suspension bridge, looking back toward the camera with a bright smile. (3) Close-up shots of the waterfall show water pouring over rocky ledges. The woman stands by a wooden railing, pointing toward the gorge. There are aerial views of the bridge spanning a deep, lush green valley. (4) The woman and the man are shown at a restaurant; close-up shots highlight bowls of noodles with large shrimp and clams, and plates of stir-fried dishes. They are seen using chopsticks to eat. (5) The couple walks along a wooden deck through a dense green forest next to a crystal-clear spring. Detailed macro shots show large fish swimming in the water, a green frog on a lily pad, and a metallic blue dragonfly on a leaf. (6) The video concludes with an aerial shot of a bridge over a rocky riverbed surrounded by trees, with the woman and man walking across it. Text overlays appear at the end over the natural scenery.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This travel vlog aims to promote tourism in Miaoli, Taiwan, specifically targeting urban dwellers looking to escape work stress. It showcases the natural beauty of Shenxianggu and the 42-Fen Spring, alongside local Hakka delicacies in Nanzhuang, presenting it as a manageable and high-value weekend getaway.
